design: Scenario: a Go connection pool or cache passes its existing unit tests but corrupts its state under concurrent load (leaked or double-handed-out resources, lost updates). Reading any single function does not reveal the problem.
The tests run a stress harness with the race detector enabled and check invariants, plus the existing behavior. The Go toolchain and race detector work in the image.
A strong engineer should need 1-3 hours. The difficulty must come from the engineering, never from obscure trivia, unstated requirements, or the work taking longer than an hour of agent time.
State every requirement the tests check in the instruction, in terms of the external interface.
